title: COACHELLA DAY 1! VIP Tour, Full Glam & Rainbow Hair
description:
COACHELLA 2018 HAS FINALLY ARRIVED! We've got our hots, boots, crop tops, and glitter ready... we've settled into our house... now it's time for the festival. 

SUBSCRIBE for MORE weirdness ►► http://bit.ly/SubClevverStyle
Watch Pt 1 - Coachella Road Trip & House Tour! ►► https://youtu.be/hJVlHcIim1U

We were lucky enough to go for our third year of VIP treatment so please enjoy this chaotic recollection of our morning prep before the big day (it takes a lot...) as well as what transpires throughout the VERY long, VERY hot, VERY fun day :) 

PS SHOUT OUT TO BRYAN MENDEZ, YOU'LL ALWAYS BE OUR GLAM MASTER!
